display_long_description:
PhysiaX app uses Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) to provide a lifelike 3D experience, ensuring accurate movement guidance and better rehabilitation outcomes.
AR Mode: See a full-scale virtual instructor demonstrating exercises in your real environment, making home-based rehabilitation more intuitive.
VR Mode: Enter a distraction-free training space, where precise 3D animations guide you through prescribed exercises with real-time feedback.
Tailored Exercise Programs: Access physiotherapist-prescribed routines, designed for post-injury recovery, mobility improvement, and strengthening.
360° Interactive Models: Observe exercises from different angles for perfect form replication.
Hands-Free Navigation: Easily control your session with hand tracking or controllers for a seamless experience.
PhysiaX is built to enhance engagement, boost adherence, and accelerate recovery—whether at home or in clinical settings.
Key Features:
✅ AR & VR Support – Choose between real-world integration or full virtual immersion
 ✅ Life-Size 3D Model Guidance – Watch a virtual physiotherapist demonstrate each exercise
 ✅ Customizable Exercise Programs – Tailored routines created by professionals
 ✅ Optimized for Meta Quest 3 – High-quality 3D motion
💡 Transform your rehabilitation experience—step into the future of physiotherapy with PhysiaX.
